_help.minLetters: Pause → Submit a word: the fewest letters a submitted word may have (Muzzy 2026-10-11: 3 — the 2-letter words are settled by Scrabble). Shorter stretches show "Submitted words must be 3 or more letters"; the server refuses them too.
_help.maxLetters: The most letters a submitted word may have — the longest word the board can hold (the word list stops at 15 too).
_help.pickerMax: How many stretches of letters the Submit a word picker lists at most (longest first).
_help.maxOpenPlayerWords: The online server keeps at most this many player-submitted words waiting (Open) for Muzzy's review; past it, new ones are dropped (the player still sees "Word submitted"). Stops a flood filling the list. The server bundles this file: a change needs a server rebuild.
_help.queueMax: Words a device keeps to send later when it's offline (oldest dropped past this).
